title: Concept: Symfony profiler toolbar served in production
description: A Symfony web-debug toolbar or profiler token in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: The profiler exposes the request, the SQL, the configuration and the session of every page it instruments, and the toolbar advertises the profiler URL.
applicability: The profiler store holds SQL, configuration and session data for every request, so one reachable token yields a full application picture.
risk: Debug tooling must not be part of a production page; the toolbar is the advertisement that leads to the store.
